title: Markov type and superreflexivity
description: Markov type of normed spaces: how far a stationary reversible Markov chain can travel in t steps. Uniformly convex norms, superreflexivity, finite representability. The theorem: a real Banach space with Markov type p > 1 is superreflexive. Its proof: a norm on sequences that remembers the order of the entries, random increasing maps and a reversible chain of them, four homeomorphisms of the line and words in a free group, and a reversible walk that moves at linear speed. One named hypothesis, the theorem of James and Enflo; everything else is proved. The course is an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026).
